levels.name: 毒箭
levels.desc: 射出一支毒箭，造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的毒素伤害，并有{chance}概率使目标陷入[中毒]。
levels.descEn: Fire a poisoned arrow that deals {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Poison damage, with a {chance} chance to inflict [Poisoned].

levels.name: 奥术炸弹
levels.desc: 发射一枚追踪的奥术弹，命中时引爆，对爆炸范围内的所有敌人造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的奥术伤害。
levels.descEn: Launch a homing arcane charge that detonates on impact, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Arcane damage to all enemies caught in the blast.

levels.name: 飞刀连击
levels.desc: 快速掷出一连串飞刀，至多攻击附近三名敌人，每把飞刀造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的物理伤害。
levels.descEn: Hurl a flurry of throwing knives at up to three nearby enemies in quick succession, each knife dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Physical damage.

levels.name: 二连矢
levels.desc: 快速射出两支箭矢，至多攻击附近两名敌人，每支箭矢造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的物理伤害。若只有一名敌人，两支箭矢都会命中该敌人。
levels.descEn: Fire two arrows in quick succession at up to two nearby enemies, each dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Physical damage. If only one enemy is available, both arrows strike it.

levels.name: 稳固射击
levels.desc: 射出一支强力的箭矢，穿透路径上的所有敌人，造成相当于{value}武器伤害的物理伤害。
levels.descEn: Loose a powerful arrow that pierces every enemy in its path, dealing {value} weapon damage as Physical damage.

levels.name: 多重射击
levels.desc: 在扇形范围内射出漫天箭雨，对范围内的所有敌人造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的奥术伤害。
levels.descEn: Loose a storm of arrows in a wide cone, striking every enemy caught in it for {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Arcane damage.

levels.name: 急速射击
levels.desc: 驻足原地，持续2秒向目标倾泻箭雨，每支箭造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的物理伤害。
levels.descEn: Plant your feet and pour a stream of arrows into your target for 2 seconds, each arrow dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Physical damage.

levels.name: 剧毒弹
levels.desc: 射出一枚强力毒素弹，命中时爆裂，对附近所有敌人造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的毒素伤害，并使其陷入[中毒]。
levels.descEn: Fire a powerful poisoned projectile that bursts on impact, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Poison damage to all nearby enemies and inflicting [Poisoned].

levels.name: 中毒
levels.desc: 每2秒受到相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的毒素伤害。最多叠加100层。
levels.descEn: Take {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Poison damage every 2 seconds. Stacks up to 100 times.

levels.name: 毒陷阱
levels.desc: 布置一个陷阱，当敌人踏上时引爆，对周围所有敌人造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的毒素伤害，并有{chance}概率施加2层[中毒]。
levels.descEn: Set a trap that detonates when an enemy steps on it, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Poison damage to everything nearby with a {chance} chance to inflict 2 stacks of [Poisoned].

levels.name: 冲击波
levels.desc: 射出一发震荡箭矢，爆发出冲击波，对身前所有敌人造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的物理伤害，将其击退，并有{chance}概率使其陷入[短暂眩晕]。
levels.descEn: Fire a concussive shot that erupts into a shockwave, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Physical damage to all enemies in front of you, knocking them back with a {chance} chance to inflict [Short Stun].

levels.name: 冰霜陷阱
levels.desc: 布置一个陷阱，当敌人踏上时引爆，对周围所有敌人造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的冰霜伤害，并有{chance}概率使其陷入[深度冻结]。
levels.descEn: Set a trap that detonates when an enemy steps on it, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Cold damage to everything nearby with a {chance} chance to inflict [Deep Freeze].

levels.name: 奥术箭雨
levels.desc: 召唤一阵奥术箭雨，对笼罩其中的敌人反复造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的奥术伤害。
levels.descEn: Call down a rain of arcane arrows that repeatedly deals {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Arcane damage to enemies caught beneath it.

levels.name: 幻影形态
levels.desc: 进入幻影形态，持续{duration}，获得{dodge}闪避几率和{attackSpeed}攻击速度。
levels.descEn: Take on a phantom form for {duration}, gaining {dodge} Dodge Chance and {attackSpeed} Attack Speed.

levels.name: 照明弹
levels.desc: 发射一枚命中时爆裂的照明弹，使附近所有敌人陷入[易伤]，持续{duration}。
levels.descEn: Fire a flare that bursts on impact, inflicting [Vulnerable] on all nearby enemies for {duration}.

levels.name: 三重击
levels.desc: 打击单个敌人，造成{damage}武器伤害。每第三击化为强化终结技，对目标额外造成{damage2}。
levels.descEn: Strike a single enemy for {damage} weapon damage. Every third blow flows into an empowered finisher, dealing {damage2} weapon damage to the target.

levels.name: 怒拳
levels.desc: 向单个敌人挥出怒拳，造成{damage}武器伤害并积蓄气势——每次命中获得+{attackSpeed}攻击速度（最多叠加20层），持续{duration}秒。
levels.descEn: Unleash a furious fist at one enemy for {damage} weapon damage, building momentum — each strike grants +{attackSpeed} Attack Speed (up to 20 stacks) for {duration} seconds.

levels.name: 震地击
levels.desc: 用武器攻击单个目标。每第三次攻击将重重击出并激起冲击波，造成范围伤害。对目标造成{damage}武器伤害，第三击对周围敌人额外造成{damage2}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Attack a single target with your weapon. Every 3rd attack strikes heavily and unleashes a shockwave, dealing area damage. Deals {damage} weapon damage to the target; the 3rd strike deals an additional {damage2} weapon damage to nearby enemies.

levels.name: 气弹
levels.desc: 向单个敌人投出凝聚的气劲，造成{damage}武器伤害。每第三发气弹命中时，还会为你恢复{heal}的最大生命值。
levels.descEn: Hurl a bolt of focused chi at a single enemy for {damage} weapon damage. Every third bolt also restores {heal} of your Max Health when it hits.

levels.name: 贯劲
levels.desc: 每次强力攻击消耗一次已积攒的贯劲。
levels.descEn: Each Strong Attack consumes one stored charge.

levels.name: 圣裁之击
levels.desc: 旋身挥出一记迸发圣光雷电的武器重击，对目标造成相当于{damage}武器伤害的雷电伤害，并对附近的敌人造成相当于{damage2}武器伤害的雷电伤害。
levels.descEn: Whirl and bring down a weapon strike crackling with holy lightning, dealing {damage} weapon damage as Lightning to the target and {damage2} weapon damage as Lightning to nearby enemies.

levels.name: 穿刺突进
levels.desc: 向前突进刺出致命一击，贯穿身前锥形范围内的所有敌人，造成{damage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Lunge forward with a piercing thrust, skewering every enemy in a cone before you for {damage} weapon damage.

levels.name: 旋风棍式
levels.desc: 在身前掀起两道龙卷风，向敌人游走，对进入其中的敌人造成{damage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Conjure two tornados before you that wander toward enemies, dealing {damage} weapon damage to any enemy caught inside.

levels.name: 双金掌
levels.desc: 双掌向前推出，凝出两只金色巨手横扫身前的扇形范围，对其中所有敌人造成{damage}武器伤害并将其击退。
levels.descEn: Thrust both palms forward, conjuring two golden hands that sweep every enemy in a wide arc before you for {damage} weapon damage and drive them back.

levels.name: 铁血体魄
levels.desc: 受到伤害降低 {reduction}，持续 {duration}。
levels.descEn: Damage taken reduced by {reduction} for {duration}.

levels.name: 神圣法球
levels.desc: 召唤一颗环绕自身旋转的神圣法球，对经过的每个敌人造成相当于{damage}武器伤害的闪电伤害。
levels.descEn: Conjure a sacred orb that circles you, striking each enemy it passes through for {damage} weapon damage as Lightning damage.

levels.name: 灵气涌流
levels.desc: 引导灵气涌流贯通全身，每秒回复{value}最大生命值，持续{duration}秒。
levels.descEn: Channel a stream of spirit through your body, healing {value} of your Max Health every second for {duration} seconds.

levels.name: 冲锋
levels.desc: 冲锋撞向目标，随后重击周围所有敌人，造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害并晕眩{duration}。
levels.descEn: Charge the target, then slam every enemy around you for {weaponDamage} weapon damage and stun them for {duration}.

levels.name: 灵体分身
levels.desc: 在身旁召唤一具灵体分身，持续{duration}。它会复现你的普通攻击与强力攻击，攻击你所攻击的敌人。
levels.descEn: Summon a spirit twin at your side for {duration}. It mirrors your Basic and Strong attacks, striking the enemies you strike.

levels.name: 踏风步
levels.desc: 踏风而行，持续{duration}，获得{dodge}闪避几率。
levels.descEn: Ride the wind for {duration}, gaining {dodge} Dodge Chance.

levels.name: 神圣雷霆
levels.desc: 屹立不动，引落神圣雷霆，每次脉冲对周围敌人造成{damage}武器伤害，并使其恍惚{duration}。
levels.descEn: Stand fast and call down holy lightning, each pulse striking nearby enemies for {damage} weapon damage and leaving them Dazed for {duration}.

levels.name: 护持之息
levels.desc: 受到伤害降低 {value}，持续 {duration}。
levels.descEn: Damage taken reduced by {value} for {duration}.

levels.name: 火球
levels.desc: 召唤一枚追踪火球，命中后爆炸，对小范围内所有敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Conjure a homing fireball that explodes on impact, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage to all enemies in a small area.

levels.name: 冰碎片
levels.desc: 投掷一枚冰霜碎片，击中单个敌人，造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Hurl an icy shard that strikes a single enemy for {weaponDamage} weapon damage.

levels.name: 电击
levels.desc: 释放一道噼啪作响的扇形闪电，击中前方所有敌人，造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Unleash a fan of crackling lightning that strikes every enemy in front for {weaponDamage} weapon damage.

levels.name: 烈焰雷电
levels.desc: 向随机一名敌人降下烈焰雷电，造成相当于{fireDamage}武器伤害的火焰伤害与{lightningDamage}武器伤害的闪电伤害。
levels.descEn: Call down a bolt of flame and lightning on a random enemy, dealing {fireDamage} weapon damage as Fire and {lightningDamage} weapon damage as Lightning.

levels.name: 冰霜新星
levels.desc: 在身周释放一圈冰霜新星，对附近的敌人造成10%武器伤害并将其冰冻。
levels.descEn: Release a nova of frost around you, dealing 10% weapon damage to nearby enemies and freezing them solid.

levels.name: 火元素
levels.desc: 召唤一个火元素，向敌人发射火球，造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Summon a fire elemental that shoots fireballs at an enemy for {weaponDamage} of your weapon damage.

levels.name: 寒冰屏障
levels.desc: 将自身封入寒冰之中，持续{duration}，期间无法行动但免疫所有伤害。冰块随后碎裂，对附近所有敌人造成冰霜伤害。
levels.descEn: Encase yourself in ice for {duration}, unable to act but immune to all damage. The ice then shatters, dealing Cold damage to all nearby enemies.

levels.name: 火陨石
levels.desc: 召唤一颗烈焰陨石，落地时爆裂，对爆炸范围内的所有敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害并使其灼烧。
levels.descEn: Call down a blazing meteor that erupts on impact, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage to all enemies in the blast and setting them Burning.

levels.name: 烈焰光环
levels.desc: 以烈焰环绕自身，持续{duration}，获得{critChance}暴击几率与{critDamage}暴击伤害。
levels.descEn: Wreathe yourself in flame for {duration}, gaining {critChance} critical hit chance and {critDamage} critical hit damage.

levels.name: 雷云
levels.desc: 在目标上方召唤一片雷云，在4秒内降下8道闪电，每道对附近的敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害，并有{chance}概率使其陷入[短暂眩晕]。
levels.descEn: Summon a storm cloud over the target that calls down 8 lightning bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage to nearby enemies with a {chance} chance to inflict [Short Stun].

levels.name: 烈焰吐息
levels.desc: 喷吐一道直线烈焰，对路径上的敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害并使其灼烧。
levels.descEn: Unleash a stream of roaring flame in a line, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage to enemies in its path and setting them Burning.

levels.name: 冰陨石
levels.desc: 召唤一颗冰冻陨石，留下持续3秒的冰寒领域，每次跳动造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害并使范围内的敌人陷入冰寒。
levels.descEn: Call down a frozen meteor that leaves a chilling field for 3 seconds, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage per tick and chilling enemies caught inside.

levels.name: 闪电风暴
levels.desc: 召唤一场闪电风暴，随机击中3个敌人，对每个敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Conjure a storm of lightning that strikes 3 random enemies, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage to each.

levels.name: 冰霜光束
levels.desc: 引导一道冰霜光束持续3秒，每次跳动对路径上的所有敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Channel a beam of frost for 3 seconds, striking every enemy in its path for {weaponDamage} weapon damage each tick.

levels.name: 范围易伤
levels.desc: 对敌人施加易伤状态
levels.descEn: Apply vulnerable to enemies

levels.name: 英勇打击
levels.desc: 对单个敌人发动迅捷近战攻击。造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害，有{chance}概率对目标施加[易伤]。
levels.descEn: A swift melee strike on a single enemy. Deals {weaponDamage} weapon damage with {chance} chance inflict [Vulnerable] to the target.

levels.name: 横扫
levels.desc: 以宽阔的弧度挥动武器，打击前方所有敌人，造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc, striking all enemies in front for {weaponDamage} weapon damage.

levels.name: 血刃
levels.desc: 刺穿一个敌人，造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害并施加流血，在{duration}内造成250%武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Pierce one enemy for {weaponDamage} weapon damage and inflict Bleeding, which deals 250% weapon damage over {duration}.

levels.name: 稳固打击
levels.desc: 对单个敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害，并为自身叠加一层[堡垒]。
levels.descEn: Strike one enemy for {weaponDamage} weapon damage and steel yourself, gaining a stack of [Bulwark].

levels.name: 嗜血
levels.desc: 每层提升你造成的伤害，最多10层。持续 {duration}，每次获得时刷新。
levels.descEn: Each stack increases the damage you deal, up to 10 stacks. Lasts {duration}, refreshed on every gain.

levels.name: 堡垒
levels.desc: 每层提升{defense}护甲与魔法抵抗，最多5层。持续{duration}，每次命中刷新。
levels.descEn: Each stack grants {defense} Armor and Magic Resist, up to 5 stacks. Lasts {duration}, refreshed on every hit.

levels.name: 蓄势待发
levels.desc: 所有伤害 +{damage}，持续 {duration}。
levels.descEn: All damage +{damage} for {duration}.

levels.name: 蓄势
levels.desc: 普攻击中积累蓄势，达到10层后消耗蓄势并触发蓄势待发。
levels.descEn: Basic Attack hits build charges. At 10 charges, consume them to activate Charged and Ready.

levels.name: 弦月势能
levels.desc: 每层提供{manaRegen}法力回复和{crit}暴击几率，最多20层。持续{duration}。
levels.descEn: Each stack grants {manaRegen} Mana Regeneration and {crit} Critical Hit Chance, up to 20 stacks. Lasts {duration}.

levels.name: 挫志
levels.desc: 造成的伤害降低 {value}。
levels.descEn: Damage dealt is reduced by {value}.

levels.name: 蔓延烈焰
levels.desc: 对周围敌人造成 {splash} 武器伤害作为火焰伤害。
levels.descEn: Deals {splash} weapon damage as Fire to enemies around you.

levels.name: 碎骨
levels.desc: 你对该敌人造成的暴击伤害提高250%。
levels.descEn: You deal +250% Critical Hit Damage to this enemy.

levels.name: 烈焰斩
levels.desc: 将火焰灌注成毁灭性的单体打击，造成相当于{weaponDamage}武器伤害的火焰伤害。
levels.descEn: Channel flame into a devastating single-target blow, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage as Fire Damage.

levels.name: 半月斩
levels.desc: 投掷一把新月形刀刃，穿透路径上的所有敌人，对每个敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Hurl a crescent blade that pierces every enemy in its path, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage to each.

levels.name: 旋风斩
levels.desc: 向敌人旋转突进，快速攻击周围的敌人，每次造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Spin towards enemies and attack surrounding enemies for {weaponDamage} weapon damage rapidly.

levels.name: 裂血连击
levels.desc: 向附近敌人挥出 3 道凶狠的切割，每次造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害并施加流血，在{duration}内造成250%武器伤害。
levels.descEn: Carve 3 savage cuts across nearby enemies, each dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage and inflicting Bleeding, which deals 250% weapon damage over {duration}.

levels.name: 内焰熔炉
levels.desc: [强力攻击]伤害 +{damage}，技能法力消耗降低 {costReduction}。
levels.descEn: [Strong Attack] damage +{damage}. Ability Mana costs reduced by {costReduction}.

levels.name: 铁棘
levels.desc: 荆棘提升{thorns}。每秒对周围的敌人造成相当于荆棘值{pulse}的物理伤害。
levels.descEn: Thorns increased by {thorns}. Every second, enemies around you take {pulse} of your Thorns as physical damage.

levels.name: 铁壁护盾
levels.desc: 每次普攻击中获得 {shield} 最大生命的护盾，持续 {duration}。
levels.descEn: Each Basic Attack hit adds a shield equal to {shield} of your Max HP for {duration}.

levels.name: 熔铸之力
levels.desc: [强力攻击]伤害提高{damage}。技能法力消耗降低{costReduction}。
levels.descEn: [Strong Attack] damage increased by {damage}. Abilities cost {costReduction} less Mana.

levels.name: 狂怒护盾
levels.desc: 以怒火屏障环绕自身，吸收最多相当于{shield}最大生命值的伤害，持续{duration}。
levels.descEn: Surround yourself with a barrier of rage that absorbs up to {shield} of your Max HP in damage, lasting {duration}.

levels.name: 怒吼
levels.desc: 4秒内提升{attackSpeed}攻击速度。
levels.descEn: Increase {attackSpeed} attack speed for 4 seconds.

levels.name: 夺命钩爪
levels.desc: 投掷锁链钩爪，穿透路径上的所有敌人，造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害，并将其拉回身前，使其陷入易伤。
levels.descEn: Hurl a hook that pierces every enemy in its path, dealing {weaponDamage} weapon damage, then reels them back to you and leaves them Vulnerable.

levels.name: 裂地击
levels.desc: 以震耳欲聋的巨响砸击地面，冲击波沿地面向前撕裂，对路径上的所有敌人造成{weaponDamage}武器伤害并使其昏迷。
levels.descEn: Smash the ground with a deafening crack, tearing a shockwave through the ground ahead of you. Deals {weaponDamage} weapon damage to every enemy in its path and stuns them.

levels.name: 铁棘
levels.desc: 以铁棘护体{duration}。荆棘提升{thorns}，并每秒向周围的敌人造成相当于荆棘值{pulse}的物理伤害。
levels.descEn: Clad yourself in iron spikes for {duration}. Thorns is increased by {thorns}, and every second you lash out at enemies around you for {pulse} of your Thorns as physical damage.

levels.name: 熔铸之力
levels.desc: 点燃体内熔炉：立即恢复{rage}最大法力值，并在{duration}内使[强力攻击]伤害提高{damage}，技能法力消耗降低{costReduction}。
levels.descEn: Stoke the forge within: instantly recover {rage} of your Max Mana, then for {duration} your [Strong Attack] damage is increased by {damage} and abilities cost {costReduction} less Mana.
